capacityMeaning: 1,493 remaining daily position-tracking keywords, not research credits. No API calls or purchases were made.

research.source: Saved authenticated Semrush browser accessibility rows
research.metricsRule: Only exact saved keyword observations supply metrics. Missing values stay null; observed zeros stay zero. Alternative captured observations are retained per keyword.

selectionRules: Map every phrase to an existing relevant page; no keyword-to-page proliferation.
Use explicit observed-query selections and distinct site-led buyer/subtask hypotheses.
Exclude the currently tracked brand domain, careers, irrelevant services, tool shopping and unsupported specialized implementation claims.
One added geographic hypothesis per selected local commercial page; retain remote-service disclosure and validate demand later.
Treat search volume, CPC and difficulty as estimates, not wins, leads or guaranteed rankings.
Priorities describe editorial fit and observed opportunity for review; they are not performance predictions.
